newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares end slightly down, Dow fall ignored.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares end slightly down, Dow fall ignored.

text.p: Italian shares ended slightly lower but well off intraday floors on Thursday with the Dow Jones' fall below the important 6,500 support area apparently having little effect.
Traders said blue chip giant ENI, heavily traded today, was dragging others down. The stock ended 1.77 percent lower at 8,80 lire. Fiat lost 1.38 percent to 5,150.
The All-share Mibtel index ended off 0.32 percent at 11,609 after an 11,498 to 11,628 range while the Mib30 Blue chip index was down 0.38 percent at 17,124 after a 16,928-17,174 range.
Traded volume overall was not spectacular, estimated at some 711 billion lire against 613 billion lire on Wednesday.

The underlying tone was cautious ahead of U.S. jobs data due on Friday with the market on hold before key non-farm payroll figures provided indications on Fed monetary policy amid worries about further rate hikes. "We're in a standby phase," one operator said.
Clothing group Benetton, which reported 1996 proft up 11.5 percent, was up 0.62 percent at 20,664 lire.
TV and advertising group Mediaset, which reported slightly lower 1996 consolidated net but proposed a higher dividend, ended 0.18 percent lower at 6,646 lire.
Olivetti closed 0.76 percent up at 613.7 lire after France Telecom agreed to buy a 49 percent stake in telecoms unit Infostrada for 165 billion lire.
March Italian investment fund data is due out Friday with inflows seen lower than in past months.
